condition: Calling cumsum/cumprod on a narrow integer ArrowDtype Series raises ArrowInvalid: overflow when the running total exceeds the storage width. NumPy-backed and masked dtypes widen to 64-bit instead.
workaround: Cast to int64[pyarrow] (or the numpy int64 dtype) before calling cumsum, e.g. s.astype("int64[pyarrow]").cumsum(), or use groupby(...).cumsum(), which upcasts.
